data.title: Nations Royalty Reports Fiscal 2027 Results, Names Alex Morrison Board Chair
data.description:
An announcement from Nations Royalty Corp. ( (TSE:NRC) ) is now available.

Nations Royalty Corp. holds Indigenous royalty interests in producing and development-stage mining projects and has an Indigenous Benefits Agreement (IBA) Advisory practice, with its portfolio focused on northwestern British Columbia. The company reported C$2.64 million in royalty revenue and C$0.21 million in net income for the six months ended September 30, 2026, while second-quarter revenue was C$0.43 million.

Nations Royalty said six-month revenue increased 382% year over year and that Brucejack royalties drove first-half profitability; it held C$16.7 million in cash and cash equivalents and no long-term debt at September 30. Alex Morrison was appointed chair effective immediately, while Seabridge announced substantial completion and successful energization of the Treaty Creek Terminal on August 27, 2026, and Cambria Gold Mines received final permits and commenced construction of the Red Mountain access road.

data.title: Irruptive Metals Raises Pimentón Interest to 61%, Securing Majority Control
data.description:
The latest update is out from Irruptive Metals Corp. ( (TSE:IRR) ).

Irruptive Metals is a Canadian copper-gold exploration company focused on high-quality projects in Chile, including its flagship Pimentón copper-gold project. Its wholly owned Chilean subsidiary amended its option agreement with Minera Tamidak, increasing the company’s interest in Pimentón from 17% to 61% through a C$3.5 million payment.

The amendment gives Irruptive majority ownership and control approximately five years earlier than originally contemplated, while reducing total payments to Tamidak from C$32.5 million to C$30.5 million. With its 61% interest, the company is entitled to appoint two of three joint-venture directors, including the chair, and the existing 2.5% gross sales royalty arrangements remain unchanged.

data.title: Artemis Drills Through Nullarbor Cover Into Sharon Dam Basement
data.description:
Artemis Resources ( (AU:ARV) ) has shared an announcement.

Artemis Resources’ maiden diamond hole at Sharon Dam has passed through the Nullarbor cover sequence and intersected interpreted Proterozoic basement at 343.3 metres below surface. Drilling was continuing in the basement at a current depth of approximately 348.8 metres.

Sharon Dam is the Madura Province’s strongest known combined magnetic and gravity anomaly, with a modelled source beginning about 400 metres below surface and extending more than 4 kilometres along strike. The target remains conceptual: its cause is unknown, and there is no certainty drilling will intersect mineralisation.

data.title: HSBC Announces Purchase of 350,000 Shares for Cancellation
data.description:
HSBC Holdings ( (GB:HSBA) ) has issued an update.
